text:
maria: Heads up — soft freeze in 3h, hard freeze in 1h. If you need a late merge exception, post justification here and tag @maria + @devon. We're planning a patch bump 2.3.0 -> 2.3.1 for this release.

release-bot: [automated] freeze-timer: 03:00:00 remaining until soft freeze.

devon: Quick reminder on policy: exceptions only for regression/critical bugfixes. No new features or opt-in flags after soft freeze. Which PR are we talking about? :thinking_face:

sam: PR #6228 — fixes an OOM path in tokenizer when handling very long prompts. It's a bug we saw in staging. We also have a backport candidate to release-2.3. Tests flaky but passing locally.

maria: Please include the exact failure mode and a short risk assessment (what could go wrong with the backport). Also we need a green unit + e2e run on the backport branch before I can consider approving.

sam: Risk assessment: small change in buffer allocation; low surface area. No API changes. Backport steps below:

```
# on main
git checkout -b backport/6228-release-2.3
git cherry-pick -x abcdef12  # tokenizer fix commit
git push origin backport/6228-release-2.3
# open PR -> base: release-2.3
```

I'll kick a CI run after pushing.

jess: If we approve, can we do a 5% canary for 30m before full promotion? That limits blast radius. I can monitor latency and error budgets. :eyes:

devon: +1 to canary. Proposed rollout: canary 5% -> monitor 30m with tracing + token-cost smoke -> promote if no regressions. Also add an automatic fallback policy to route to previous model-variant if error rate exceeds threshold.

maria: Approved conditional on: 1) green e2e on backport branch, 2) updated PR description with risk + rollback steps, 3) add fallback route in rollout config. @sam update the PR and ping when CI is green.

sam: Will do. Pushing backport now and will attach test logs. ETA: ~45m. Thanks.

qa-ops-bot: Regression job queued: release-2.3/backport-6228 -> job 71234. Notifying @jess.

jess: I'll watch the job and start canary once you give the go. If anything spikes I'll abort and roll back.

maria: Great. If no more exceptions come in, the hard freeze will be enforced at the hard cutoff. Keep all communication here so we have an audit trail. :thumbsup:
